title: Monomial factorization across a coordinate split
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $J$ be a set of coordinates in the $n$-dimensional sign cube. For finite coordinate sets $S$ in $J$ and $T$ outside $J$, and sign assignments $y$ on $J$ and $z$ outside $J$, the monomial of the full sign assignment formed from $y$ and $z$, at the union of the lifted sets $S$ and $T$, equals the product of the monomial of $y$ on $S$ and the monomial of $z$ on $T$.
hypotheses_covered: $J$ is a finite set of coordinates among the $n$ coordinates
$S$ is a finite set of coordinates in $J$
$T$ is a finite set of coordinates outside $J$
